He served as a governor of various provinces, including Egypt and Syria, under the caliphs Muawiya I and Muawiya II. Bulus was known for his military prowess and his ability to maintain peace and stability in the provinces under his rule.

Al-Bulus Al-Khawlani was a famous poet and scholar from the Khawlan tribe in pre-Islamic Arabia. He is known for his poetic works, which often depicted the beauty of nature and the Arabian desert. Bulus also played a significant role in the early Islamic community, serving as a judge and a military commander under the first rightly-guided caliph, Abu Bakr.
